messages:
li: Quick thread — proposing concrete kernel switch criteria so regions don't flip during traffic spikes.

maya: +1, we need thresholds that account for quantized vs fp16 behavior.

sanjay: What triggers? p95 latency delta, token/s drop, and quality regression alert?

li: Draft rules: 1) If p95 increases by >12% and throughput drops >8% for 3 consecutive 1-min windows -> candidate for switch. 2) Require no quality regression on eval set (safety hold). 3) Canary: 1% traffic on target kernel for 30m.

ashley: Can you paste the config snippet for ops to implement?

li: Sure:
```
{
 "switch":{
  "p95_delta_pct":12,
  "throughput_drop_pct":8,
  "windows":3,
  "canary_pct":1,
  "canary_duration_mins":30
 }
}
```

bench-bot: Bench summary uploaded: https://internal/redwood/bench/1771234567 — H100 FlashV3 vs Triton FP16 across eu-west/us-east.

maya: Note: FlashV3 q8x2 had lower tokens/sec on short sequences in eu-west due to kernel startup. Need hysteresis per seq-length bucket.

sanjay: Agreed. Add seq_len buckets: <=128, 129-512, >512. Only compare within same bucket.

li: Also: don't switch if model quantized variant shows >1% quality degradation on regression eval. We have a "quality_fail" flag from evals.

ops-bot: Reminder: switching impacts cache warming; add warmup window 15m after switch before considering metrics stable.

ashley: So final flow: detect candidate -> run canary -> warmup -> monitor p95/throughput + evals -> commit/rollback. :white_check_mark:

li: I'll open a PR with the recording thresholds and a small runbook. Thanks.

sanjay: Can we also log kernel metadata (vendor, commit, build flags) in the trace? ops wants that for rollbacks.

li: yes — add kernel.name, kernel.version, quantization and compile flags to trace span.

maya: One more thing — regional capacity plans: if switch causes throughput loss, automatic route to fallback region for critical customers only.

ashley: filing a follow-up ticket to add customer tier routing and SLA guardrails.

li: Good. If no objections I'll enact this as a default policy next week.

maya: No objections. :+1:

sanjay: Fine by me.

bench-bot: Auto-note: experiment 1771234000 shows switch reduced cost 7% on a40 fleets when safe.
